subject: Re: Azure Marketplace: initial validation for Acme Analytics offer
messages:
From: Azure Marketplace Onboarding <azure-marketplace@microsoft.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-28T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Azure Marketplace: initial validation for Acme Analytics offer

Hi Ben,

Thanks for submitting the Acme Analytics SaaS offer. Before we can move to the technical gate we need a few items clarified so the publishing team can approve the catalog entry: 

1) Tenant / publisher proof: please provide a tenant claim PDF (tenant id + publisher alias + signed contact).
2) Offer manifest: a sanitized manifest (JSON) showing SKU mapping, plan ids, and sample ARM payload.
3) Co-sell checkbox: confirm whether you intend to opt into Microsoft co-sell and provide the partner-of-record mapping.
4) SKU entitlements and billing model: confirm metered vs. subscription and list sample price points.

Can you share the items by EOD Monday so we can target a publish window the following week? If you have a preferred publish window or blackout dates, include those.

Thanks,
Azure Marketplace Onboarding
Marketplace Publishing Team
Microsoft Corporation

Attachment: marketplace-initial-checklist.pdf (see checklist of required proofs)
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Azure Marketplace Onboarding <azure-marketplace@microsoft.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-29T09:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Azure Marketplace: initial validation for Acme Analytics offer

Hi —

Appreciate the clear list. We can provide everything requested. Quick status: 
- Tenant proof: attached tenant-proof.pdf (signed by Acme legal + tenant id).
- Offer manifest: attached offer-manifest.json (redacted demo values in dev SKU).
- Co-sell: Acme intends to opt into co-sell; partner-of-record is Acme Corp (PON: 3109).
- Billing model: subscription monthly and annual; base SKU + seat add-ons included in manifest.

Marissa, Karthik — looping you in for technical validation and any missing artifacts the marketplace team wants before certification. 

Azure team — preferred publish window is week of Nov 8 (no blackout on our side). If you'd prefer an earlier slot we can accelerate.

Next steps I propose: (1) Marissa to confirm that manifest and SaaS connectivity match the marketplace runbook, (2) Karthik to sign off on co-sell entitlements and legal pointer, (3) we provide DocuSign envelope for procurement sign-off once marketplace confirms.

Ben
Ben Carter | Senior Sales Manager | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192

Attachments: offer-manifest.json, co-sell-checklist.xlsx
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-30T11:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Azure Marketplace: initial validation for Acme Analytics offer

On Thu, Oct 29, 2026 at 09:02, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com> wrote:
> Azure team — preferred publish window is week of Nov 8 (no blackout on our side).

Hi team,

I reviewed the attached offer-manifest.json and ran a brief connectivity smoke test against Acme's SaaS entitlement callback URL. Notes and asks below: 

- Manifest: SKU IDs look consistent but plan IDs 1002/1003 are swapped relative to Acme's billing catalog — please confirm which is the paid plan vs. trial.
- Callback endpoint: the SaaS fulfillment callback (POST /api/marketplace/fulfill) responds with 200 but payload validation fails on the purchaseToken field when sequence contains long GUIDs. We recommend trimming GUID length in the sample.
- ARM template: please include the minimal ARM example mapping to service principal grant; we need to validate the SPN permissions for consumption metrics.
- Security proofs: request that Acme add an entry for 'retention_policy' in the manifest (retention: 30 days) so catalog metadata shows data residency.

I've attached a short tenant-proof.pdf (redacted) that Ben uploaded; it covers the tenant id + signoff. Once Acme confirms the two manifest fixes above I can re-run the validation and sign off on the technical gate. 

Marissa Cole | Principal Product Ops, Marketplace Integrations | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (650) 555-0168

Attachment: tenant-proof.pdf
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Azure Marketplace Onboarding <azure-marketplace@microsoft.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Azure Marketplace: initial validation for Acme Analytics offer

Thanks everyone — quick signoff from my side. 

I validated the co-sell mapping against Acme's partner record; PON 3109 is correct and they are eligible for incentive routing. Procurement has issued an internal approval note (procurement-approval-note.pdf).

Ben: please request Acme to update the two manifest items Marissa called out (plan ID mapping + shortened purchaseToken) and re-upload the manifest to the Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cAcme-Onboarding.

Azure team: once the manifest is updated, Marissa will run one final technical smoke test and then we request a publish window the week of Nov 8. We will route the DocuSign envelope for final signature (link below) immediately after your approval.
